newsitem.title: USA: Maytag's Hoover brand helped Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Maytag's Hoover brand helped Q3 results.

text.p: Maytag Corp said strong sales in its Hoover vacuum brand helped boost its third-quarter results.

"A strong performance by our Hoover brand and lower costs of materials drove operating income in the quarter up 7.6 percent," chief executive Leonard Hadley said in a news release. "Additionally, we continue to benefit from our earlier financial restructuring that has lowered our debt and interest expense."
Operating income for the quarter was $80.1 million, up from $74.4 million a year ago, the appliance maker said.

Driven by Hoover sales, Maytag's home appliance business had record third quarter sales of $694.6 million, up 1.3 percent from $685.7 million in the third quarter of 1995. Operating income for home appliances was $80.6 million in the quarter, an increase of 3.4 percent from $77.9 million in the year earlier period, the company said.
But major home appliance sales were off from the third quarter of 1995, because of highly competitive market conditions, the company said.
The company also said it had completed the repurchase of 8.2 million shares out of its 10.8 million share stock repurchase plan by the end of the quarter, which added $0.03 a share to earnings.
The company reported net income of $0.40 a share in the quarter, compared to $0.26 a share a year ago. The year ago earnings included a $16.5 million pre-tax charge from settlement of a lawsuit.
Maytag shares were unchanged at 20-5/8 Thursday.
